Re: 

County ofMaui, Hawaii v.  Hawaii Wildlife Fund, et al. 
No.  18-260 

Dear Mr.  Harris: 

I represent Petitioner in the above-captioned matter.  On behalf of both parties, I am writing to 
request an extension oftime for the merits briefs and joint appendix in this case, as follows: 

Petitioners brief(andjoint appendix): May 9, 2019 

Respondents brief: July 12,2019 

Both parties have agreed to this proposed schedule, which would allow the Court to hold oral 
argument during the October 2019 sitting. 

Please let me know if you need any additional information. 

Very truly yours, 

~ Elbert Lin 

Counsel for Petitioner
